lead: A `Core` row cannot land ahead of its helper.
body: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/test.rs:2968`'s `every_row_names_a_symbol_this_module_claims` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/lib.rs:518`'s `every_registered_member_has_an_implementation_address` sweep every row in `registry::CLASSES` for an address, and `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/conformance_coverage.rs:52` wants a case writing the member's own call spelling. Land the row, its card, its `address()` arm, its helper and one case as one group, and strike the ratchet line in the same edit.
